respuesta: Tinción de flagelos de Bacillus cereus.
claves: Las células tienen numerosos flagelos, que usan para moverse. B. cereus es una causa común de intoxicación alimentaria.

imagen.autor: modification of work by Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
imagen.descripcionOriginal: A flagella stain of Bacillus cereus, a common cause of foodborne illness, reveals that the cells have numerous flagella, used for locomotion. (credit: modification of work by Centers for Disease Control and Prevention)
